meta.name: cellxgene-context
meta.description: Guide for integrating CellxGene Census single-cell data with ENCODE bulk experiments. Use when users need cell-type-specific expression context for ENCODE regulatory data, want to deconvolve bulk ENCODE signals, or validate regulatory elements at single-cell resolution. Trigger on: CellxGene, single-cell atlas, cell type expression, Census, cell type specificity, single-cell context, scRNA-seq atlas.

copy.tagline: 整合单细胞与批量实验数据，解析细胞类型特异性调控
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在单细胞分辨率下验证ENCODE调控数据。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate single-cell and bulk experiments to resolve cell-type-specific regulation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to validate ENCODE regulatory data at single-cell resolution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你查询 CellxGene 单细胞数据中特定基因在不同细胞类型的表达量，从而解释 ENCODE 批量实验的调控信号来自哪些细胞。
howto.when: 当你提到 CellxGene、单细胞图谱、细胞类型表达等关键词，或需要为 ENCODE 数据提供细胞类型特异性背景时触发。

say.text: 胰腺中 INS 基因在哪些细胞类型表达？
帮我查一下肝脏中 ALB 基因的细胞类型特异性。
say.note: Claude 会分析 ALB 是否只在肝细胞表达。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can query CellxGene Census for cell-type-specific expression of a gene, helping interpret which cell types drive bulk ENCODE regulatory signals.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention CellxGene, single-cell atlas, cell type expression, or need cell-type context for ENCODE data.

say_en.text: Which cell types express INS in pancreas?
say_en.note: Claude queries CellxGene and returns expression by cell type.

say_en.text: Check cell-type specificity of ALB in liver.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes whether ALB is hepatocyte-specific.
